program.name: Conditioning 35
program.subject: Conditioning
program.blurb: Thirty-five minutes of conditioning: an EMOM and an AMRAP, or a circuit and a ladder.
program.about: Conditioning that fits about half an hour. One day is an EMOM of lifts and cardio, then an AMRAP; the other a full-body circuit, then a ladder of two moves. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Both later levels add reps.
